description:
Queue another transcription attempt for a voice note in this conversation. Only re-transcribes; never drafts or sends. A refusal says why: a retry is already running, the limit is reached, or the audio is gone.

Luca operation: POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages/{messageId}/media/{mediaId}/retry
Required scopes: conversations:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:queue_ops; data sensitivity: redacted
Requires Idempotency-Key. Provide idempotencyKey for safe retries, or the server will generate one.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. If omitted, the MCP server generates a unique key for this call.

name: luca_conversations_media_retry
title: Retry a voice-note transcription
